Xocai Cacao Deluxe Truffles
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Friday, November 9, 2012 - 12:35pm

Ingredients




4 Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets
1/2 cup dates (chopped)
1/2 cup almonds
1 tsp almond extract
1 tsp honey
1/2 cup cocoa powder (or shredded coconut)

Preparation

1 Chop Nuggets in food processor until chocolate chip size. Add dates, nuts and extract and process until texture resembles bread crumbs. Drizzle honey while processing until mixture forms soft dough. Roll into 1-inch balls and coat with your choice of cocoa powder or shredded coconut. Makes 12 balls

About

Xoçai is the worlds creator of truly HEALTHY Chocolate! You may be wondering if chocolate can really be healthy. People across the globe have discovered that Xoçai Healthy Chocolate truly can make a difference in one’s health. Learn more here: www.xocai.com
